title: Fema / RBI | RBI Amends HFC Directions to Align Recovery Agent Rules with NBFC Responsible Business Conduct Directions
description: Fema / RBIRBI's Third Amendment Directions, 2026 require HFCs to comply with NBFC Responsible Business Conduct provisions on loan recovery from 1 January 2027.The post RBI Amends HFC Directions to Align Recovery Agent Rules with NBFC Responsible Business Conduct Directions appeared first on TaxGuru.
